name: cable standing lat pushdown (rope equipment)
description: A straight-arm pushdown with a rope on a high cable. It isolates the lats with almost no help from the arms.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing it, hinging slightly forward.
Grab the rope with straight arms.
Push the rope down to your thighs, keeping your arms nearly straight.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the rope rise slowly to shoulder height.
